caption: The drawing depicts a single roll-top desk, centered on a plain, light beige background with no other objects present. The desk is colored in various shades of brown, suggesting a wood material. It features a curved roll-top surface with a decorative pattern, below which is a flat writing area. On the right side of the desk are four vertically stacked drawers, each with ornate handles and keyholes. The left side is supported by a solid panel and decorative support beams. The top of the desk has an elevated shelf with two carved side supports and a decorative, symmetrical back panel. There is a small rectangular mirror or panel at the center of the upper shelf area. The artist's signature, "R. N. MILLER," appears in small capital letters near the bottom right.
title: Secretary
